# S1.10 — Land the compilation model (§3.2, R-2.1.3 C0/Stage 1)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §3.2 (`R-2.1.3` — the C0/Stage-1 slice per
§3.2.14) · ADR-0019/0020/0021/0022 (as amended) · ADR-0025 D2 · ADR-0087 ·
ADR-0090 · ADR-0103 · ADR-0106 · ADR-0124 §5 · ADR-0143 D2 · ADR-0148 ·
CF-049/CF-056/CF-199
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/014_S1.10__compilation-model.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.1.3**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.9` (stacked) · **Stage:** 1 · **Live
stage:** offline-only

## Summary
Lands the §3.2 compilation model's C0/Stage-1 slice as the new persistent crate
`crates/hh-compiler` — a pure, content-addressed pipeline over declared inputs
only (no clock, randomness, environment, network or live registry):

- **Stage 0 `accept`** — sealed-definition input only; re-asserts sealed
  markers and that the canonical-form hash matches the recorded `version_id`;
  *calls* `hh_assembly::validate_assembly` and carries the
  `ValidationReport` forward (never re-implements `validate` — ADR-0025 D2);
  `accept_bytes` is the canonical-bytes seam the `hh-compile` binary uses.
- **Stage 1 `link`** — calls `hh_assembly::link_precheck` first; a surviving
  `version_selector` is `C-LINK-1`/`LinkError{unbound_slot}` and **zero
  resolutions hold by construction**: `VariantView::variant(version_id)` is a
  pinned-lookup seam with no resolver in the signature (closes DF-S1.9-3).
  Binds the profile chain (`extends`, precedence/specificity order,
  `AmbiguousSelector` on ties, chain overrides ⊆ owned fields under the
  declared per-field merge policy), the registered target specs
  (`unknown_target` is a typed refusal), `capability_requires` preconditions
  (ADR-0087), conditioned-rule debt completeness (`missing_debt_record`),
  expired-debt rules refused unless `compile_for_expired` — the explicit
  recorded intent — is a declared compile input (ADR-0020 §7), and
  `NoProfile` unless a `fallback_profile` with a dated debt hypothesis binds
  (ADR-0124 §5). Bound profile rules are checked for C0 expressibility
  (AC-CP-05): `interaction_mode = native_fc` only; `tool_shape` may name only
  the C0 family set (`["native_fc"]` — `SurfaceFamily` records are
  C1/Stage-5); undeclared dialect narrowing is `DialectNarrowingUndeclared`.
- **Stage 2 `lower_native` → `RuntimePlan/1`** — the closed plan-node set
  `{loop, step, branch-on-validator, delegate, stop-rule}` with the ADR-0103
  Phase-2 attributes (`step.mode`, `step.output_schema`, `loop.replan_on`);
  the control boundary's `EnvelopePolicy` lowers into the budget-envelope and
  stop-rule nodes (ADR-0106); tool table; policy tables derived **only** from
  `Permission`/`EffectClass`/`Budget` entities; context-policy parameters;
  validator bindings; artifact/ledger ids; `hir_node_id` on every node;
  `PlanError{unsupported_construct}` — the ceiling surfaces as an error,
  never a silent fallback.
- **Stage 5 `seal_outputs` → `CompiledBundle`** — `derivation_key = idp/1`
  over canonical inputs (definition `version_id`, bound variant
  `version_id`s, profile content hashes, target-spec versions, compiler
  version); `bundle_id = idp/1` over canonical outputs; the total trace map
  (`trace(map, locator) → {hir_node_ids[], rule_ids[], target_rule_ids[]}`,
  typed `TraceError` on an unknown locator); the static `lcd_report`
  (composes the stage-0 derived results — never recomputes, CF-050);
  `EquivalenceEvidence{E1..E7}` with static E1–E3/E7 and staged `n/a` for
  E4–E6 (`n/a(open-world)` for open-world capabilities — T-LCD-15, never
  0/fail); `SealError{non_canonical}` on re-encode mismatch.

`ModelProfile/1` is the spec's contract verbatim: the member list including
`tests{…}` (carried as data — §5b owns its semantics at Stage 5), the closed
thirteen-kind `ProfileRuleKind`, and the `CapabilityDeclaration` field list
(incl. structured `reasoning_replay{field, opaque}` and a carried-not-read
`compatibility_token`). `CompileError` is the closed §3.2.10 set —
`TargetError`/`ProtocolVersionMismatch` are declared ahead of their stage-4
emitters (CC8).

Additive (CC8) changes to landed crates: `hh-hir` exports
`closed_world_tools` (the single rule home `seal`/`accept_bytes` share — CC1)
plus `wire::document_from_json`/`boundary_json`/`boundary_from_json` codec
wrappers (CC7); `hh-assembly` registers the S1.10-owned diagnostics
(`C-LINK-3…9`, `C-PLAN-2`, `C-SEAL-1`) and exports the diagnostic codec pair.

## Acceptance criteria (Stage-1 halves all executable and green — 12 acceptance + 46 unit tests)
- **AC-CP-01** — two in-process compiles + one out-of-process `hh-compile`
  run of identical inputs yield byte-identical bundles; the compile signature
  takes no clock/env input.
- **AC-CP-03** — every emitted stage-1 element resolves through `trace`.
- **AC-CP-05** — a profile rule requiring an inexpressible surface raises
  `UnexpressibleSurface` as an error.
- **AC-CP-06 (Stage-1 half)** — incomplete debt → `missing_debt_record`;
  expired rules warn under recorded intent and land in
  `lcd_report.conditioned_rules`.
- **AC-CP-10 (Stage-1 half)** — E1–E3/E7 `pass` or typed `fail`; E4
  `n/a(open-world)` for open-world capabilities.
- **AC-CP-11 (T-12)** — `hh-compile` out-of-process produces bytes identical
  to the in-process compile.
- Stage-3 halves (AC-CP-02/-04/-06-retire/-07/-08/-09/-12/-13) → **DF-S1.10-1**
  → S3.2, per §3.2.14.

## Deferrals
- **Closed:** DF-S1.9-3 — the stage-1 `link` consumer lands; zero resolutions
  by construction (`VariantView` is pinned-only) + `link_precheck` first.
- **Opened:** DF-S1.10-1 — the §3.2.12 stage-3 acceptance halves → S3.2.

## Decisions
ADR-0241 — crate shape; snapshot views (no resolver); the canonical profile
contract (the Phase-3 review caught and corrected an invented rule-kind set);
the C0 family set; recorded-intent expiry; the closed failure set; one `idp/1`
identity primitive.
